lines.style: Speak fluent, casual General American English to a friend after tasting their cooking: flat, unimpressed, deadpan, a short hesitant pause after "It's...", then "mid" said plainly with falling intonation. About one and a half seconds.
Speak English as a happy, proud friend who thinks he was just complimented on his cooking: "Mid?" with a bright rising tone, then a delighted, cheerful "Thanks!". About one and a half seconds.
Speak fluent, natural General American English, clear and friendly, like saying a new slang word for a learner: one word, falling intonation. About one second.
